answer: Require each new agent to post a decaying bond that only unlocks after peers it has never transacted with attest its work across several epochs. Think of trust as a summit reached slowly: a sybil farm must lock fresh capital per identity and survive a long tundra of low rewards before earning anything, while any graph vertex whose attesters cluster too tightly gets its bond slashed, so cloning a thousand agents multiplies cost, not payoff.
